compare._comment: crops: height band [lo, hi] as a fraction of the mesh height; the crop is placed where most UV points of the band vertices fall

bind._comment: binder: 'skin_tokens' (target default, tools/run_skin_tokens.py, GPU) or 'donor' (labelled FALLBACK, tools/run_bind.py, MakeHuman donor weights, CPU). Shipped as 'donor' until the SkinTokens proof passes; flip with: python tools/set_default_binder.py skin_tokens. fallback_to_donor: when binder is skin_tokens and it fails the gate or its prerequisites are missing, run the donor bind and label the receipt FALLBACK.

skin_tokens._comment: tools/run_skin_tokens.py: SkinTokens (VAST-AI, MIT) skins a body onto the psyche-106 rig (demo.py --use_skeleton). GPU. Paths come from config.local.json (skin_tokens_repo_dir, skin_tokens_python). Gate = bind.gate plus the relative-to-control clause.
skin_tokens.launcher_note: optional path of an external launcher (python launcher.py <in.glb> <out.glb>, NUM_BEAMS from num_beams) that carries the Windows/ROCm workarounds; empty = demo.py as before. Checked to exist before the run; the receipt records params.launcher and params.launcher_sha256. Not part of this repo.

qc._comment: tools/run_qc.py thresholds, loose to start; tune from real receipts. A metric whose limit is null, or whose input is missing (no concept, no budget), is skipped, not failed.

moge._comment: Optional MoGe-2 input (tools/qc_moge.py, plugin 0.1.13): faceting of --render against the concept and normal/depth agreement. OFF by default; when off or unavailable qc behaves as before. Thresholds null = scores are recorded in params.moge but never fail. Definitions: docstring of tools/qc_moge.py. Weights: local only (model_dir null = config.local pixal3d_moge_dir, else work_dir/models/moge-2-vitl). Python: config.local moge_python (default the Pixal3D venv). CPU by default so it never takes the GPU lock.

clean._comment: fallback pre-bind mesh clean (tools/run_clean.py -> bind/clean_mesh.py); distances in metres; voxel_m 0 = voxel remesh off (then the original texture is kept as is)

fit._comment: mode 'z_frac' scales each gear mesh uniformly so its height spans the body height fraction below and centres it on the body in x/y; mode 'none' trusts the incoming scale and placement

helpers._comment: optional secondary motion: gear vertices below anchor_z_frac of body height shift up to max_blend of their weight onto the nearest rig helper bone whose lower-case name contains a pattern

lit._comment: Lit PBR presentation look (run_stills.py). Light positions are in units of body height H from the rest-pose bounds: x,y from the bounds centre (camera looks along +Y from -Y), z from the feet. size is in H. energy is watts at ref_height_m and scales with (H/ref_height_m)^2. Set enabled false for the old flat sun look.

character._comment: tools/run_character.py: stage names in run order; pauses and timeouts in seconds

flux._comment: plugin 0.1.6; names agreed with the Factory (flux_kit_fast.py). steps and ref_long_by_group are the quality policy (plugins/factory/lib/cf_flux.py): ref_long_by_group 0 = full-size reference required, N = long side may drop to N. The rest are speed switches, zero pixel change: env CF_ATTN_BACKEND, CF_VAE_TILING, CF_VAE_SLICING, CF_CACHE_REF, CF_INPROC override them; vae_tiling/vae_slicing null = models.flux.

pixal3d._comment: plugin 0.1.10. Pixal3D (TencentARC, MIT) single view via tools/run_pixal3d.py. Attention is sdpa (flash-attn and natten are CUDA-only; NAF, loaded by torch.hub, imports natten: see tools/pixal3d_shims). Paths under config.local.json (pixal3d_*), defaults under work_dir. Presets are first settings: the A/B against TRELLIS on the same input and seed decides.
pixal3d._naf_comment: plugin 0.1.15. naf true = NAF feature upsampler (torch.hub valeoai/NAF, needs natten: tools/pixal3d_shims/natten is a pure-PyTorch stand-in, first on sys.path). false = bicubic feature upsample, no hub, no natten; the receipt then carries params.naf=false and params.quality_label (a rough proof, never a final). Hub cache = config.local pixal3d_torch_home, default work_dir/models/torch-hub (code in hub/valeoai_NAF_main, checkpoint in hub/checkpoints/naf_release.pth).

export._comment: plugin 0.1.18 hook point, default empty = upstream cumesh to_glb. module = a python module whose install() replaces o_voxel.postprocess.to_glb before the upstream call (multi-view entry only); path = its folder (relative to the repo or absolute). The CPU exporter pixal3d_glb_cpu from the export-fix PR (branch factory/pixal-export-0.1.16) is meant for this: cumesh crashes on this ROCm build (io.hip:134) and inference_mv.py uses the same call as single view. Label such a run PX-CPUGLB. This PR does not depend on that one.

multiview._mv_model_dir: empty = config.local pixal3d_mv_model_dir, else work_dir/Pixal3D-run (patched offline pipeline_mv.json + ckpts link to models/Pixal3D/ckpts); upstream --model_path for multi-view.
multiview._comment: plugin 0.1.18. Multi-view input (tools/pixal3d_mv.py): sheet cut-outs joined into one shape, cameras GIVEN (upstream inference_mv.py, ckpts/*_mv, pipeline_mv.json). Rig = the upstream example (20 degree fov, distance 3.1192, elevation 0). subject_frac = subject height as a fraction of the frame (upstream example views 0.83 to 0.89). facing = which way the subject looks in the picture (by eye): left -> azimuth 90, right -> 270; three-quarter cells are nominal 45/315.

ab._comment: plugin 0.1.14: A/B harness Pixal3D vs TRELLIS (tools/run_ab.py, tool ab_shape). Decision rule from OpenTrident Dev: same cut-out PNG, same seed, about 10 min wall each (wall_budget_s is REPORTED, not a kill; wall_hard_cap_s is the safety kill), TRELLIS first, one GPU job at a time under the lock; blind scores 0-10 on face, hair, colour match, bake faults; Pixal3D wins only if it beats TRELLIS by win_margin or more on win_criteria_needed criteria AND its bind gate is no worse.

gates._comment: plugin 0.1.4 gates (plugins/factory/lib/cf_gates.py). token_floor = the robot's proven setting (preset tokens98k); hero stays equal until a higher setting is measured on this GPU; presets with no tier (drafts, benchmark profiles) have no floor. A floor is a minimum, not a cap: any run may sample more. Ceiling test (GPU free only): robot_1076 at 131072 and 196608, --attn-auto-gb 28; hero floor = highest that completes in under 2x the 98304 wall time.

motion._comment: plugin 0.1.8 motion_generate (tools/run_motion.py), 0.1.12 second backend. ARDY (nv-tlabs/ardy, Apache-2.0 code, NVIDIA Open Model Agreement weights) in the Motion-312 venv, or Kimodo (nv-tlabs/kimodo, Apache-2.0 code, NVIDIA Open Model License weights) in its own Kimodo-312 venv (transformers 5.1.0 vs ARDY 5.8.1), then a Blender retarget onto psyche-106 into a Mixamo-format clip GLB. Paths live in config.local.json (motion_*, kimodo_*; the Kimodo ones default under work_dir). Text encoder = LLM2Vec on a LOCAL Llama 3 mirror: no network, no token. DRAFT: nothing here has run on a GPU.

somaskel77._comment: Kimodo output (SOMA 77 joints). UNRUN name table, same content as SKELETON_TABLES in tools/motion/retarget_blender.py (a test keeps them equal).

cloth._comment: plugin 0.1.18: cloth stage (tools/run_cloth.py, tool cloth). CPU Blender only, no GPU. Rest-pose mode: the gear part is a Cloth object, the T-posed bound body a Collision object, the shoulder/neck vertices are pinned, it is simulated until settled, and the settled mesh becomes the part's new REST pose. Per-clip mode is a stub (NotImplemented).

presets._comment: silk and cotton are the values of Blender 5.2 scripts/presets/cloth/Silk.py and Cotton.py (bending_damping stays at Blender's 0.5). wool is ours: a heavy cloak cloth, about 0.45 kg/m2 against cotton 0.3.

collision._comment: Body collider = the evaluated T-pose body (rig in REST pose) decimated to proxy_faces. Cloth side: distance_min is the standoff the cloth keeps from the body surface. Collision modifier side: thickness_outer is the body's outer skin, friction is the cloth-on-body friction (Blender default 5, 0 to 80).

prep._comment: A part over max_faces is decimated (collapse, UVs kept) to about target_faces before the sim so the sim stays CPU-friendly; the decimation is reported.

pin._comment: Pin rule: a cloth vertex is pinned (vertex group weight 1.0, pin_stiffness 1.0) when its height is within height_band_m below the highest point (head or tail) of the pin bones (z >= top - height_band_m) AND its 3-D distance to the nearest pin bone segment (head to tail of every bone whose lower-case name contains a pattern) is <= radius_m. Weight falls linearly from 1 at radius_m*soft_inner to 0 at radius_m when soft_inner < 1.

sim._comment: Simulated frame by frame at fps. Settled = the p99 speed of the FREE vertices stays under settle_p99_speed_mps for settle_frames in a row after min_frames; otherwise it stops at max_frames and says it did not settle. The point cache lives on disk in a temp folder under the work dir (deleted after the run unless keep_cache).

gate._comment: max_penetration_m is measured against the FULL-resolution body (not the proxy). Cloth pinned at the neck may touch the skin there, so the gate is on the free vertices. Inside = majority of 6 axis rays odd (the TRELLIS body is not watertight).

guard._comment: Extra Blender guard (Strategy order 2026-11-01): free RAM >= min_free_ram_gb, exclusive lock file (config.local blender_lock, default <work_dir>/blender_job.lock; wait lock_wait_s if its pid is alive), and no Flux START / model-load line in the newest queue log of logs_dir in the last flux_window_s (a Flux cell needs about 14 GB at load).

proof._comment: tools/cloth/proof_render.py: same camera, resolution, samples and three-point rig as tools/ab/turntable_blender.py (config ab.render, nothing new), only the angles below, cloak cloth vs baked one-piece.

materials._comment: Plugin 0.1.17 MATERIALS stage (tools/run_materials.py): scanned CC0 PBR sets (config/materials.json) on a gear part under the A/B three-point rig (ab.render). CPU Blender only, no GPU lock; RAM, Flux-load and blender_job.lock guards in tools/materials/blender_guard.py.
